purpose: Teach: 縮減/教示/貸し付け/取り付ける/通帳/差し止め/持ち株/引き下げる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Direct eye contact. No flourish. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed. Brief pause after the period—lets the directive settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様にも丁寧にご教示いたします
lines.en: Understood. I'll brief our key accounts on the changes with full care.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Measured tempo. Slight forward lean. Shows he's already thinking through logistics. Finishes with quiet assurance—he's got this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様への貸し付け限度額を見直せ
lines.en: Review the credit limits we extend to our valued clients.
lines.style: Steady, declarative. Controlled breath. No inflection that softens the order. Eyes forward. The assumption of competence without need for elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電光看板を取り付ける手配を進めました
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already arranged for the LED signage installation to move forward.
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact. Quick tempo—shows initiative. No hesitation. The tone of someone reporting progress without seeking praise, just acknowledging it's done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の通帳管理に厳しく対応しろ
lines.en: Tighten controls on employee bank account management throughout the company.
lines.style: Firm, unambiguous. Slight drop in pitch on the last clause for emphasis. No room for interpretation. The voice of someone who has seen negligence before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。違法販売の差し止め申請を準備しております
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're preparing the paperwork to halt the illegal sales operations immediately.
lines.style: Calm, assured. Professional tempo. Understates the seriousness slightly—this is routine for him. Delivers the update as though it's already handled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、持ち株比率を見直せ
lines.style: Clipped, deliberate. Pause between words. The economy of language from someone accustomed to boardroom precision. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入れ価格を引き下げる交渉を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll push forward with negotiations to reduce our procurement costs.
lines.style: Confident closure. Steady pace, slight lift at the finish line—sets up the next action. Tone of someone wrapping up a briefing and moving to execution.
